integrity.claim_type: proved mathematical identity and asymptotic classification
integrity.computational_checks: Exact rational examples and independent quadrature; supplementary, not infinite proof
integrity.critical_proof: Simplex Gram inversion, orthogonal factor decomposition, positive-part integral, inclusion-exclusion, beta-to-exponential limit, strict convexity

scientific_limitations: Uniform volume on product of exactly two nondegenerate simplices.
Globally affine real L2 projection, not tensor-product bi-affine projection.
Dimension-ratio optimality is asymptotic only; finite optimal splits and alternative convex bodies not classified.
Primary literature coverage limited by inaccessible material; novelty is best knowledge.
title: Sharp affine least-squares norms on products of two simplices and the balanced-dimension law
